Skills
action-plan
How to turn an agreed breakdown into an executable action plan — every action carries owner, timing, metric, and a stop condition, and deferrals are recorded with reasons. Load when the principal says "so what do we do" or asks for a plan.
campaign-evidence-recording
How to record live-verification evidence in this repo: graded claims, red-green, note in the same diff
client-ui-contribution
How to contribute UI to the DSH web client from this package — the classic-script bundle constraint, the slot system (inject + register), the boot graph, and why out-of-tree Remote namespaces do not materialize. Use when adding a sidebar panel, a brand mark, a right-sidebar tab, or any browser-side surface, or when a client plugin reports a pending entry that waits on a service.
company-facts-provenance
How to ground a small-company management question in real facts: locate the company knowledge base (kb/org.md, kb/<role>/CHARTER.md, deliverables/<slug>/{final,drafts}), grade every cited number 核实/dev盘可核/未核实, enumerate before you decompose, check the clock so an unfinished period is never read as a finished one, and say "the number does not exist" instead of inventing scope. Load when a request carries company numbers or names ("our sales dropped 20%", "our custome
